C-14.Name: Marketing site for Mark built with opendesign.ai
C-14.Summary: User idea (session 2026-09-18): "было бы неплохо с помощью opendesign.ai сделать сайт для марка". Build a product landing site (features, screenshots, download links per channel: in-app updater feed, GitHub Releases DMG, Homebrew cask) using opendesign.ai as the design/tooling baseline. Hosting and domain TBD (GitHub Pages is the default candidate). NOT IMPLEMENTED — planning artifact so the idea is not lost.

Problem.Description: Mark has no product site; discovery is GitHub-only.
Problem.RootCause: Port focused on the app; marketing surface never existed.

Goals.R-1: Landing page: hero, feature list (WYSIWYG markdown, tabs, themes, copy-as-HTML/plain-text, live reload), screenshots, changelog feed.
Goals.R-2: Download section wired to the three live channels (Releases latest.json feed, DMG, brew cask) so it never shows a stale version.
Goals.R-3: Design produced via opendesign.ai; static output committed to this repo and served from GitHub Pages.

Constraints.Constraint: Download links must be derived from the live release feed, never hardcoded versions.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Docs site replacement (VitePress already lives in /site).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Static site deploys on every release tag with the correct current version surfaced.

AffectedAreas.M-046: release feed drives the site download section (planned)

C-14.VerificationIntent: Static build CI check + feed-driven version assertions in a smoke test; manual visual QA.

Approval.ApprovedBy: user (session 2026-09-20): "с помощью opendesign.ai сделать сайт для марка" — execution approved; local Ollama engine chosen (cloud key optional for later polish).
Approval.ApprovalScope: Implement: OpenDesign v0.22.2 installed, generation via local Ollama, output integrated into /site (VitePress home), GitHub Pages deploy.
